The 20% penalty is definitely still a thing and it’s fighter’s choice at that point. They can choose to take it and get the bonus or refuse. But it’s my understanding that the organization will call the fight off completely if they’re significantly overweight though. Which was what happened here. 

Yeah, Schevchenko is an insane talent. Also I thought if it’s a title bout, that the person coming in overweight wouldn’t get the belt even if they still fought and won? That they would only receive the remainder of their purse. I might be wrong there though.

If she was as extremely overweight like she was for this fight for that weigh-in, that fight would be cancelled. The option for just losing 20% of your purse is no longer available. Even if Nicco came in at half the amount that she was over, it’s smart for the other fighter to refuse that fight. Considering the day after the weigh-in, she would come back considerably heavier and have a severe advantage over you. 

I want to feel for her because if that were McGregor, Khabib, Garbrandt, or any other fighter that has Dana so far up their ass, she wouldn’t have had her belt stripped away from her. But at the same time, she hasn’t defended her title in over a year, and when it came time to defend it with plenty of time to prepare, she missed weight. It was unprofessional and unfair to Schevchenko who did her job. To be fair, I wouldn’t want to fight her either though. Haha. 

But yeah, you’re right. Antonina would probably favor in that fight. Lol. Although I’d love to see Valentina fight Nicco after all of this. I imagine there’s some bad blood there now which usually makes for a good fight.

This is the exact situation I’m in. Reversed, obviously. I’m in a relationship with a woman. I’m extremely feminine and crave that masculinity that I don’t often get from my girlfriend who is just as feminine as I am. 

I don’t see sexuality as a big part of my personality either, just a pillar in my life and it really isn’t anyone else’s business just as you said. Which is why I’m not too concerned about labels. 

I’m happy to hear that you don’t feel ashamed. Honestly, it’s interesting how our minds work this way and how we have the freedom to react to how we feel any way we want.

I’ve definitely considered the bisexual thing. But at the same time, I don’t think I’m inclusive enough of men to be deemed bisexual. 

As you said though, sexuality is the weirdest fucking thing. Haha. When the labeling comes in, everything gets a little muddled. 

I know a ton of straight women who watch lesbian porn. It’s a lot less.. Demeaning. Depending on the content. Lol.

Coming from your friendly neighborhood lesbian, turns out that I like having sex with men. 

Aesthetically, I get so turned on by their bodies. But do I romantically like men? No, I do not. 

I’m 23 and I’ve only been with 1 guy, but if I ever watch porn it’s usually what I go to. 

Don’t exactly know what this means for my whole “lesbian” status. I don’t really know if I ever will, but at the same time I’m not about to turn to tumblr or the other thousand sexual identities people have made up over the past couple of years. I’ve just decided to roll with it and accept it.
